pr_title: crosscluster/logical: replan with correct asOf time
pr_body:
Previously the replanner re-used the original planning request. As a result, we were always replanning with the original replicated time. This replicated time stop working for replanning once it is outside of the gc window on the source.

Fixes #128776
Release note: None

issue_context.title: crosscluster/logical: replanner uses wrong asOf time.
issue_context.body:
**Describe the problem**

The replanner re-uses the original planning request that includes an AsOf time generated from the original replicated time.  As a result, replanning may stop working after the original replicated time has fallen out of the replanning window.

```

job replanning check failed to generate plan: ‹ERROR: crdb_internal.plan_logical_replication(): batch timestamp 1723350180.000000000,0 must be after replica GC threshold 1723368774.038005946,0 (SQLSTATE XXUUU)›
```



Jira issue: CRDB-41200
